has been compared by some to [[Pete Maravich]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.nbadraft.net/2006u16championships001.asp |title=The Next Pistol Pete |work=NBADraft.net |language=English |format=HTML |accessdate=2006-08-14}} Says former [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] guard [[Juan Ignacio Sánchez|Pepe Sánchez]], who at the time played at the point guard position for [[Asociación de Clubs de Baloncesto|Spanish ACB League]] rivals [[CB Málaga|Unicaja Málaga]]: {{cquote|I think he's a freak of nature, being so young and being so skilled and also so cool all the time. You can see that he knows what he's doing. He's not playing out there with pros based only on his talents. He knows the game and he can only improve. I think he'll be a great player. It all depends on him, but I personally think he's going to be great.|15px|15px|Pepe Sánchez{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/8109/180/item |title=Sweet 16: Joventut's Rubio steals the show |work=Euroleague.net |format=HTML |date=2007-02-13}}}} Despite his notability, he has been carefully shielded. [[Joventut Badalona|DKV Joventut]] and Rubio's parents agreed not to make him available for interviews until his 18th birthday on 21 October 2008. However, the restrictions were ended a few months early once he was selected for the [[Spain national basketball team|Spanish national team]] that would play at the [[Basketball at the 2008 Summer Olympics|2008 Olympics]].{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/espnmag/story?id=3469578 |title=La Pistola |first=Chad |last=Nielsen |publisher=''[[ESPN The Magazine]]'' |date=2008-07-01 |accessdate=2008-12-17}} Rubio held his first press conference in early June 2008. During the event, he criticized what he saw as the [[National Basketball Association|NBA's]] emphasis on individual play and blamed poor team play for the recent struggles of the [[United States men's national basketball team|US national team]], saying in [[Catalan language|Catalan]], "Basketball isn't one-on-one. It's five-on-five, plus the bench." He then switched to [[English language|English]], commenting on his competitive nature — "If I'm losing, I'm going to do everything possible to win. I do the same thing on the court" — and how he practiced moves that he saw in videos of Maravich — "If I can do some magic, I do it." Rubio has been featured in [[SLAM Magazine]]. ==Professional career== Rubio debuted in the [[Liga ACB|Spanish ACB League]] in the 2005-06 season with [[Joventut Badalona|DKV Joventut]]. He won the [[EuroChallenge|FIBA EuroCup]] championship with Joventut that year. He led the Spanish ACB League in steals during the 2006-07 season. He also won the Spanish ACB League's [[ACB Rising Star Award|Rising Star Award]] that season. Rubio was also named the 2007 and 2008 [[FIBA Europe Young Men's Player of the Year Award|FIBA Europe Young Player of the Year]].[http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.roundID_6328.compID_qMRZdYCZI6EoANOrUf9le2.coid_9OATnqWKJ9o1wNe96uC,N3.articleMode_on.html FIBAEurope.com Rubio article.] He made his [[Euroleague]] debut on October 24, 2006, versus [[Panathinaikos BC|Panathinaikos]] of [[Athens]] as Joventut's backup point guard for [[Elmer Bennett]]. Rubio averaged 2.8 assists per game in his first season of Euroleague play. He won the [[ULEB Cup]] championship with Joventut in 2008. He was also voted the Spanish ACB League's best point guard in 2008. Rubio won the 2008 [[Mr. Europa|Mr. Europa Award]]. In 2009, his club Badalona raised the amount of money that his contract paid per year from €80,000 euros [[net income]] to [[Euro sign|€]]300,000 [[Euro|euros]] net income.[http://www.in-the-game.org/?page_id=378 In The Game Rubio salary and raise.][http://www.basketme.com/2.0/noticia.php?id=23104 Basketme.com Rubio gets a raise. (Spanish)] He was named the Defensive Player of the Year for the Spanish ACB League 2008-09 season, and he also lead the league in steals and assists that season. Rubio declared himself eligible for the [[2009 NBA Draft]] on April 20th 2009.[http://www.marca.com/2009/04/20/baloncesto/acb/1240233918.html Marca.com Ricky Rubio confirma que se inscribirá en el 'draft'. (Spanish)][http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2009/news/story?id=4084579 ESPN.com Agent confident Rubio to stay in draft.] Rubio's agent is [[Dan Fegan]].[http://www.interbasket.net/news/2036/2009/04/21/ricky-rubio-declares-for-2009-nba-draft/ Interbasket.net Rubio declares.] ==Spanish national team== ===Under-16 national team=== In August 2006, Rubio led the junior Spanish national team to the [[FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]. During the tournament Rubio achieved three [[triple-double]]s and one [[quadruple-double]]. In the 110-106 double overtime finale victory over Russia, Rubio scored 51 points, the first player to do so in [[FIBA]] tournaments since [[Luol Deng]] (in 2001), grabbed 24 rebounds, made 12 assists, and stole the ball seven times—a performance unprecedented in the tournament's history. He also forced the first overtime with a three-point, buzzer-beating shot from mid-court. Rubio was subsequently named the [[Most Valuable Player]] of the tournament after leading it in points, rebounds, assists and steals. ===Under-18 national team=== In 2007, Rubio played for Spain's U-18 national team at the [[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]. In 28 minutes per game, he averaged 19.1 points, 5 rebounds, 4.8 assists and 4 steals per game. Despite his leadership, Spain finished the tournament in 5th place. Rubio did not participate at the 2008 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship, due to his commitment to the Spanish senior national team. ===Senior national team=== {{MedalTableTop}} {{MedalCountry|[[Spain national basketball team|Spain]]}} {{MedalSport|Men's [[Basketball]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[Summer Olympics]]}} {{MedalSilver|[[2008 Summer Olympics|2008 Beijing]] | [[Basketball at the 2008 Summer Olympics|National Team]]}} {{MedalBottom}} The young Spaniard was selected to take part in the [[Spain national basketball team|Spanish National Team]] which participated at the [[Basketball at the 2008 Summer Olympics|2008 Olympics Basketball Tournament]] in Beijing, China. The team was composed of such players as [[Pau Gasol]], [[José Calderón (basketball)|José Calderón]], [[Rudy Fernández (basketball)|Rudy Fernández]], [[Marc Gasol]], [[Raúl López]], [[Jorge Garbajosa]], and [[Juan Carlos Navarro (basketball)|Juan Carlos Navarro]], among others. He played in the 2008 Olympics Basketball Tournament's gold medal game against [[United States men's national basketball team|Team USA]], and thus became the youngest basketball player to ever play in an Olympic basketball final. Rubio shared the Spanish national team's silver medal after his team suffered a 118-107 defeat. ==Awards and accomplishments== ===Pro career=== *Won 3 [[Catalan basketball league|Catalan National
